answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and let that stake wander through escrow as the agent works: each completed job releases a little, each verified complaint freezes a little. A karst of hollow shell identities collapses because each fake must fund its own stake, and a dune of cheap copies cannot form when every grain costs real collateral. Sybils stop being free: an attacker pays the full stake for every identity, and one proven fraud burns them all.
